title: Anup Gupta To Exit Nexus Venture Partners After 16 Years
summary: Anup Gupta is stepping down from his role as a partner at venture capital (VC) firm Nexus Venture Partners after…
llm_summary: Anup Gupta, who has been a partner at Nexus Venture Partners for 16 years, is leaving the firm to pursue new opportunities. During his tenure, Gupta helped shape Nexus’s investment strategy and backed several high‑growth Indian startups across sectors like fintech, healthtech, and SaaS. His departure marks the end of a long‑standing era for the VC house as it looks to the next generation of leadership.
